Description: Direct emissions related to sources under the direct control of the Inditex Group (combustion in boilers, own vehicles, etc.).
Methodology: Scope 1 emissions are calculated based on the consumption of the various fuel types and their corresponding emission factors.
Emission factors: DEFRA (Department for Environment Food & Rural Affairs), v.3.0, 2021.

Description: These are indirect emissions related to the generation of electricity acquired and consumed by the Inditex Group.
Methodology: Scope 2 emissions are calculated based on the consumption of electricity in each market and their corresponding emission factors.
Emission factors: Location-based method: - IEA (2021), Emission Factors Market-based method: - Contractual instruments for renewable energy: (PPA, EACs, etc.) - IEA (2021), Emission Factors

Scope: Scope 3 - Category 1: Purchased goods and services
Description: All upstream (cradle-to-gate) emissions generated in Inditex's supply chain from the manufacture of products made available to customers.
Methodology: Extraction of raw materials: emissions are calculated based on the tonnes of the various raw materials consumed and the corresponding emission factors. Spinning and weaving: emissions are calculated based on the energy consumption and the corresponding emission factors. Energy consumption is estimated on the basis of raw materials consumption ratios. Wet processes and cutting and sewing: Emissions are calculated using the Greenhouse Gas Protocol's Scope 3 emissions calculator.
Emission factors: IEA (2021), Emission Factors. DEFRA (Department for Environment Food & Rural Affairs), v.3.0, 2021.

Description: Emissions generated as a result of the extraction, production and transportation of capital goods purchased and/or acquired by the Company.
Methodology: Emissions are calculated using the Greenhouse Gas Protocol's Scope 3 emissions calculator.
Emission factors: Scope 3 evaluator, Greenhouse Gas Protocol and Quantis
